bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the conditional coverage of predicted confidence intervals across different translation language pairs to identify imbalances (e.g., under-coverage for into-English versus out-of-English translations).

Measuring the conditional coverage of uncertainty intervals stratified by continuous human-annotated translation quality scores (Direct Assessments) to identify if the model underestimates uncertainty for low-quality translations.
Assessing conditional coverage across different bins of the model's own predicted uncertainty scores to reveal biases and imbalances in confidence calibration.
